spec.description: GPS constellation monitoring for raspberrypi-ntp — satellite signal strength, DOP, fix status, and sky coverage

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_sky" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "nSat")
  |> last()

spec.title: Satellite Elevation (°)
spec.description: Higher elevation = stronger signal and less atmospheric distortion

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_satellites" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "el")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Current Satellite Status
spec.description: Current snapshot of all visible satellites

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_satellites" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ss" or r._field == "el" or r._field == "az" or r._field == "used")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["prn", "constellation", "_field"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["prn", "constellation"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      wiki_url: if r.constellation == "GPS" then "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_GPS_satellites"
                else if r.constellation == "GLONASS" then "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_GLONASS_satellites"
                else "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GNSS"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["prn", "used", "constellation", "ss", "el", "az", "wiki_url"])
  |> sort(columns: ["ss"], desc: true)

spec.title: Fix Status
spec.description: Current GPS fix mode. 3D fix is required for reliable PPS timing discipline — a drop to 2D or No Fix is the earliest warning sign of degraded stratum-1 accuracy.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_tpv" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mode")
  |> last()

spec.title: GPS Time Error Estimate (ept)
spec.description: gpsd's own estimated timestamp error, in seconds. A rising trend indicates the GPS receiver's raw time solution is degrading — worth comparing against chrony's PPS-disciplined offset, since PPS should correct for most of this.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_tpv" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ept")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Satellites Visible (nSat) vs Used (uSat)
spec.description: nSat = satellites visible (signal detected); uSat = satellites actually used in the fix. A persistent large gap (e.g. nSat≫uSat) suggests antenna/multipath issues; uSat alone drives GPS timing accuracy.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_sky" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "nSat" or r._field == "uSat")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Signal Strength by Satellite (dB-Hz)
spec.description: Signal strength per satellite PRN. Higher = better lock.

spec.title: DOP Values Over Time
spec.description: Four Dilution of Precision metrics plotted together: HDOP (horizontal), TDOP (time), GDOP (geometric), PDOP (position). All are unitless multipliers describing how much your satellite geometry amplifies measurement error — lower is better, with values under ~2 considered good and above ~5 indicating poor sky geometry (e.g. obstructions, very few satellites). TDOP specifically tracks timing accuracy and is the one most relevant to this server's role as an NTP source.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_sky" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "hdop" or r._field == "tdop" or r._field == "gdop" or r._field == "pdop")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
